notify.title: Gunkly: {chore}
notify.test_body: This is a test message from Gunkly. If you can read it, this channel works.
mail.verify.subject: Confirm your email address for Gunkly
mail.verify.body:
Hello {name},

Confirm your email address to finish setting up your Gunkly account:

{link}

The link works once and expires in {hours} hours. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this message.
mail.reset.subject: Reset your Gunkly password
mail.reset.body:
Hello {name},

Someone asked to reset the password of your Gunkly account. To choose a new password, open:

{link}

The link works once and expires in {hours} hour. Signing in again on all devices will be needed afterwards. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message: your password has not changed.
mail.otp.subject: Your Gunkly sign-in code
mail.emailchange.subject: Your Gunkly email address is being changed
mail.emailchange.body:
Hello {name},

A change of the email address of your Gunkly account to {newEmail} was requested. It only takes effect once the new address is confirmed.

If this was not you, change your password now and sign out other devices.
done.undo_note: Pressed by mistake? You can undo this for 5 minutes.
done.undone_heading: Undone. The chore is open again.
done.invalid_heading: This link is not valid any more.
done.invalid_note: It may have been used, may have expired, or the chore may have changed. Open Gunkly to see what is due.
mail.inactive_warn.subject: Your Gunkly account will be deleted if you stay away
mail.inactive_warn.body:
Hello {name},

You have not signed in to Gunkly for a long time. To keep our data small and your data safe, accounts that stay inactive are deleted. If you do nothing, your account and your personal data will be deleted on or after {date}. Households where you are the only member with access are deleted with it.

To keep your account, just sign in once:

{url}

If you no longer need it, you do not have to do anything.
mail.inactive_final.subject: Final notice: your Gunkly account will be deleted on {date}
mail.inactive_final.body:
Hello {name},

This is the final notice. You have still not signed in to Gunkly, so your account and your personal data will be deleted on or after {date}. Households where you are the only member with access are deleted with it. Deleted accounts cannot be restored.

To keep your account, sign in once before that date:

{url}
notify.inactive_warn: Your Gunkly account will be deleted on or after {date} unless you sign in. Open {url} to keep it.
notify.inactive_final: Final notice: your Gunkly account will be deleted on or after {date} unless you sign in. Open {url} to keep it.
